text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot two Umamusume with a
bunch of
sweets laid out on a table.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you care to join us, Trainer?
We're
holding a princess candy party. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since we were both little, Fine and I
have
dreamed of filling our bellies with
tasty sweets!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was never allowed to have such treats
at home, so what better time is there to
fulfill the dream than now? ☆ These
Japanese candies look so
delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's ever so nostalgic. ♪ I remember how
I would
dash to the candy shop every
day as a child.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How admirable! Even from a young age,
you had
the agency to leave your castle
alone to go
shopping?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, oh yes! ♪ The shopping district
was like my backyard garden! I strode
around gallantly
with lots of ten-yen
coins in hand!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So you learned the particulars of
managing
money by mingling with the
city folk? How
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami, you are truly an Umamusume
of firm
and responsible character. You
have completely
won my admiration! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're going to make me blush! Both
my
spirits and appetite are through the
roof!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gah, you're right. I shouldn't overeat!
choice_data_list: No letting your appetite go comple...
Let's eat as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! My maid often told me the same
thing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, my mother was no joke either! If
she caught
me overindulging, she'd
strike like a bolt of
lightning!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two engage in a lively
princess
discussion while enjoying their
candy in
moderation.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! A princess should eat a lot
and laugh a
lot!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I wholeheartedly agree. ♪ I must
hurry
and try every tasty treat that this
country has to
offer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's guzzle this all down until our
stomachs are
about to burst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two enjoy a rousing candy
party,
eating until their stomachs are
filled to the brim.
